description: This source file contains security-related utility functions for password hashing and token management, including hashing passwords, verifying passwords, creating JWT access tokens, and decoding them. It relies on external libraries 'bcrypt' and 'jwt' and interacts with a configuration module.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a password string using bcrypt with a salt, returning the hashed password as a string.

methods.name: bool verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash, returning True if they match.

methods.name: str create_access_token(*, sub: str, email: str)
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with subject and email claims, signed with a secret key, including issued at and expiration timestamps.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising exceptions if invalid or expired, returning the token's payload.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(*, sub: str, email: str) -> str:$/
